pages.title: Wing Fortress Zone
pages.text: Wing Fortress Zone is the tenth level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). In the game's own table of music it comes right before the unused Hidden Palace Zone tune, as number 0F.

pages.title: Eggman's triumph
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review (2010), the reviewer JezMM said that the Wing Fortress Zone tune "perfectly represents Eggman's triumphant creation".
